description: A performance-installation project — "a quest for self-awakening" — staged with three collaborators. Poster, trailer, and teaser.
story: Body and space, treated as materials. The poster is hand-painted — watercolour ground, Devanagari brushwork — because the performance itself was analog: movement, breath, a basement at 3 PM. The films keep that honesty; nothing is graded into a trailer it wasn't.
